unity-catalog-oss:rest-spec-support:curr.notes: Exposes an Iceberg REST endpoint (/api/2.1/unity-catalog/iceberg) that serves Delta UniForm tables to Iceberg clients such as Trino and DuckDB. The 0.6.0 server advertises exactly seven endpoints - list and load namespace, table exists, load table, load view, report metrics and list tables - and loadTable vends short-lived storage credentials for the table location.
caveats: Read-only: no create, commit, drop or rename endpoints, so tables can't be created or committed through IRC
No Iceberg view support: the load-view endpoint exists only so clients can probe table-then-view and always returns 404
Only Delta tables with UniForm enabled are visible to Iceberg clients
Every IRC endpoint requires metastore OWNER, so external access can't be scoped per schema or per table
Nested namespaces aren't supported, and vended credentials are hard-coded to read privileges

unity-catalog-oss:v2-spec-support:curren.notes: UniForm generates format v2 Iceberg metadata for Delta tables, which the server (Iceberg 1.11.0 since 0.6.0) parses and serves over the REST endpoint.
caveats: UniForm requires deletion vectors to be disabled on the Delta side, so the generated v2 metadata never carries delete files

unity-catalog-oss:v3-spec-support:curren.notes: No format v3 support announced for the OSS server. It parses metadata with a v3-capable Iceberg library (1.11.0), but the only tables it serves are Delta UniForm tables, whose generated metadata targets format v2; native Iceberg table lifecycle is a v0.7 and beyond roadmap item.

unity-catalog-oss:managed-offering:curre.notes: Self-hosted OSS project; the managed Unity is a different, proprietary product.

unity-catalog-oss:serves-own-irc:current.notes: The IRC path is read-only - the server advertises no create, commit, drop or rename endpoints - and it serves Delta UniForm tables read-as-Iceberg rather than its own Iceberg tables. Credentials are vended (loadTable returns short-lived, location-scoped storage credentials), but held to the read-and-write bar this criterion applies to every catalog, it does not qualify. Iceberg tables with create, read and write are a v0.7 and beyond roadmap item.

unity-catalog-oss:rw-foreign-irc:current.notes: No bundled query engine, so the catalog cannot itself read or write foreign tables over IRC: foreign-table access needs separate compute.
caveats: The source rubric scores 'no engine' as 0 (BYO compute), so this is recorded as not supported rather than unknown

unity-catalog-oss:federation-broker:curr.notes: No catalog-of-catalogs brokering in the OSS edition; federating other sources (JDBC, Iceberg REST, Hive metastore) is a v0.8 and beyond roadmap item.

unity-catalog-oss:multi-engine-multi-clo.notes: Spark, DuckDB and Daft via the UC-native API, plus read-only IRC for any Iceberg client; the unitycatalog-hadoop module extends vended-credential reuse to engines such as Flink and Trino. Storage covers S3, ADLS and GCS.

unity-catalog-oss:governance-cred-vendin.notes: Credential vending is real: storage credentials and external locations vend short-lived, path-scoped credentials (AWS STS, Azure user-delegation SAS, GCS OAuth) with automatic renewal. Governance is the weak half - authorization is off by default (server.authorization=disable), grants are coarse object privileges, and named-role RBAC, row filters, column masks and ABAC are all still uncommitted on the roadmap even beyond v0.8.
caveats: The Iceberg REST path vends read-only credentials and requires metastore OWNER
